input.summary: Hit the first inline target to light the spinner, then test it once. Repeat a strong spinner; if it is weak, finish the inline bank for 5X before returning to it.

steps.text: Plunge for the top saucer. Watch the miss and saucer feeds before you shoot the upper playfield again.
modeNotes: Skill shot: The top saucer adds one P-A-R-T-O-N letter. Wide misses can enter either side of the upper playfield.

steps.text: Hit the first inline drop target immediately. This lights the spinner.
modeNotes: Lit spinner: Each registered spin scores its lit value. A shot that registers 10 to 15 spins is useful. A shot with 20 or more spins is excellent.

steps.text: Shoot the lit spinner once. Count the spins and watch the return.
If the spinner registers at least 10 to 15 spins and returns safely, repeat it from the left flipper.
If the spinner is weak, continue through the inline bank. Stop when the bonus multiplier reaches 5X.
modeNotes: Bonus multiplier: The second inline target lights 2X. The third lights 3X. The fourth lights 5X. The multiplier applies to the end-of-ball bonus.

steps.text: At 5X, return to the lit spinner. From the right flipper, transfer the ball left when the transfer is safe.

From the right flipper, shoot left of the bumpers and nudge the rebound toward the upper-left DOLLY targets or top saucer. Use this letter route in qualifying; in match play, return to a strong lit spinner.
modeNotes: Letters: The top saucer and inline drops add P-A-R-T-O-N. The upper-left standups add D-O-L-L-Y. Each lit letter adds 2,000 to base bonus.

input.overview: In Dolly Parton, the first inline drop lights the spinner, while deeper inline drops raise Bonus X through 5x. Test the spinner after the first target and repeat it when both spin count and return are strong; otherwise finish the inline bank before returning to it. In qualifying, complete D-O-L-L-Y and P-A-R-T-O-N once to hold 22,000 base bonus and twice to hold 44,000 across later balls.

fallback.title: Lit spinner
fallback.when: Use this plan when deeper inline targets or upper-left rebounds are dangerous.

steps.text: Hit only the first inline target.
Repeat the lit spinner from the left flipper.
Do not chase the 20,000 target behind the inline bank.

alternatives.title: Qualifying bonus build
alternatives.when: Use this plan in a best-game format or when the spinner is weak.

steps.text: Finish the inline bank for 5X bonus.
From the right flipper, shoot left of the bumpers and nudge rebounds toward the upper-left DOLLY targets or top saucer. The inline drops and top saucer add PARTON.
Complete one full letter set early for a held 22,000 base. Complete a second set for a held 44,000 base.
modeNotes: Held super bonus: The 22,000 and 44,000 bases remain available for later balls. With all ten letters and 5X, the maximum end-of-ball bonus is 320,000.

steps.text: Do not complete a third set unless Specials score points. A third set awards Special and resets the letters.
Complete DOLLY with the five upper-left standups and PARTON with the top saucer and inline drops.
The first complete DOLLY PARTON set locks a 22,000 base bonus for later balls.
Complete the set a second time to lock a 44,000 base bonus.

playfieldReferences.label: DOLLY standup targets
playfieldReferences.description: The five red standups arc around the upper-left corner.

playfieldReferences.label: Drop target
playfieldReferences.description: Hit the first inline drop target immediately.

playfieldReferences.label: Inline drop-target bank
playfieldReferences.description: The four inline drop targets run up the upper-right side.

playfieldReferences.label: Spinner
playfieldReferences.description: The spinner is beside the right wall, below the inline bank.

playfieldReferences.label: Pop bumpers
playfieldReferences.description: Shoot up the left side of the pop bumpers.

playfieldReferences.label: Top saucer
playfieldReferences.description: The skill-shot saucer is at the top center of the playfield.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Test the inline bank from the right flipper. Use the backhand only if this copy makes the shot cleanly.

techniques.name: Transfer to the left flipper
techniques.instruction: When the ball reaches the right flipper, transfer it left before you repeat the spinner. Use only a transfer that is controlled on this copy.

techniques.name: Upper-left rebound
techniques.instruction: Shoot up the left side of the pop bumpers. Nudge the rebound toward the DOLLY targets or top saucer.

cautions.issue: Most drains begin in the pop bumpers or below the DOLLY targets on the left side.
cautions.response: Watch the pop exit. Nudge before the ball gains speed down the left side.

cautions.issue: Inline-target rebounds can move toward the center drain. A miss into either side post is worse.
cautions.response: Hit the bank only from a controlled ball. Stop after the first target when the rebound is not safe.

cautions.issue: The 20,000 target behind the inline bank is tight, and a miss can drain.
cautions.response: Ignore it unless the shot and return are both safe. Use the lit spinner instead.

input.simpleOverview: In Dolly Parton, the first inline drop lights the spinner, and the next three inline drops raise Bonus X through 2x, 3x, and 5x. Hit the first drop and test the spinner; repeat it when it registers at least 10 to 15 spins with a safe return. When the spinner is weak, finish the inline bank for 5x and use the upper-left D-O-L-L-Y targets and top saucer to build held bonus.

content.summary: Hit the first inline target to light the spinner, then test it. Repeat a strong spinner; if it is weak, finish the inline bank for 5X before returning to it.

steps.title: Light and test the spinner
steps.text: Hit the first inline drop target to turn on the spinner's higher value, then shoot the lit spinner once.

steps.title: Repeat a strong spinner
steps.text: If the spinner registers at least 10 to 15 spins and returns safely, keep repeating it from the left flipper.

steps.title: Adapt to a weak spinner
steps.text: If the spinner is weak, finish the inline bank for 5X, transfer the ball left when safe, and return to the lit spinner. Ignore the tight 20,000 target behind the bank and the 5,000 lane below the spinner.

Complete the set again to lock 44,000, then finish the inline bank for 5X.
